svg.text: VCO ring core: 4 delay cells (inverter pair + latch) + tap buffers + phase drivers
Supply pins: VSS (drawn as supply symbols at each device pin; ground symbol = VSS)
Devices: GF180MCU PDK (nfet_03v3 / pfet_03v3 / ppolyf_u_1k / cap_mim_2f0fF); W, L in metres (u = um); bulk drawn to source where tied, otherwise tagged.
